title: If the Sun Vanished, Earth Wouldn't Notice for 8 Minutes
description:
If the Sun vanished, how long before Earth noticed? Light and gravity both travel at the speed of light, so for 8 minutes 20 seconds nothing changes, then the sky goes dark and Earth flies off in a straight line.

0:00 The Sun is gone. You wouldn't know.
0:43 Why the sky stays bright for 8 minutes
1:36 Gravity has a speed limit too
2:34 What Earth does at the 8:20 mark
3:28 News can't outrun light

This is a thought experiment: the Sun cannot really vanish. The orbit, timer and train comparison are illustrative, and some figures (such as the 1.7 second gamma-ray delay in GW170817) are rounded.
